# Ridgeline

> Ridgeline is a free web app (installable PWA) for hiking trail maps that work offline. Find trails near you, see distance, climb, estimated time and difficulty, save a trail's map to your phone, navigate with live GPS and record hikes as GPX files. No accounts; everything stays on the device.

Trail data comes from OpenStreetMap contributors (via Geofabrik extracts for Washington State and the Overpass API elsewhere). Map tiles come from OpenFreeMap. Elevation data comes from Open-Meteo.

- App: https://hike.bobolearns.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/mishamachine/ridgeline
